rollup.narrativeSummary: As of 18 March 2026, 12 topics are being tracked across Allianz Technology SE. One topic was formally closed this period (PCA option, topic 8b). No topics are currently in Blocked status. Three systems (FMP, FMQ, FMX) are flagged for concentration risk, appearing across 4–5 topics each. The most urgent items for the coming week are the 22 March deadline shared by 0474 parameter SR work (FMD/FMQ), HMP volume migration/OS patching, and Enqueue Replication Server parameter SRs. 17 decisions were recorded across all topics. Two active risks are open: a process accountability gap around security notes implementation (RISK-001), and a conversion running over the weekend without team input on FMX (RISK-002). 4 actions are due in the next 7 days. The oldest open items date back to early January 2026, giving an average age of approximately 46 days for open workstreams.
